submission.justification: Sensor-T2 has the best unirradiated resolution but only 82% efficiency after 2e16 neq/cm^2, against a requirement of at least 97%, so it is excluded. Of the two remaining options, T3 has better resolution than T1 at every thickness I simulated. T3 meets the efficiency requirement with 98.5%. Its resolution is best near 150 um (9.05 um). I simulated T3 at 50, 100, 150, 200 and 250 um, and the minimum is at 150 um, so I did not scan finer. The irradiated resolution was not simulated, because the tool only models unirradiated sensors.

requirements.evidence: Among radiation-qualified options, T3 at 150 um gives 9.05 um. T1 gives about 14 um at 100 um. The thickness scan for T3 was 10.17, 9.32, 9.05, 9.75 and 10.39 um at 50, 100, 150, 200 and 250 um.

requirements.requirement: Suitable for innermost-layer radiation environment (>=97% efficiency at 2e16)
requirements.evidence: T3 has 98.5% efficiency after 2e16 neq/cm^2. T2 has 82% and fails.

requirements.requirement: One of the three listed technologies

requirements.evidence: The simulation covers unirradiated sensors only. Irradiated resolution was not measured.
